name: entries
description: Which timeframes vote for the entry, with the exits of the V2 design held fixed (no ladder, 20 USD target and stop per 0.01 lot, 4 h pause after a loss, force-close off).

open_weights.note: timeframes whose RSI and MACD slope signs add up to the OPEN score; H1+M15 is live

entry_s.note: OPEN score needed: 2 = one timeframe fully aligned (live), 4 = two timeframes fully aligned

entry_agree_s.note: how far the M15 force-close score has to agree with the entry: 2 = fully (live), 0 = not at all

trend_tf.note: entries only with this timeframe's trend; null = no filter

slope_on_closed_bars.note: true = the slope signs are read from closed bars only, so a signal cannot appear and vanish inside a bar

entry_confirm_s.note: the entry direction has to hold this many seconds before an order is sent
